report.explanation: All current evidence is healthy: checkout span OK at 70ms, gateway 200/ok logs, error_rate 0.001, p95 76ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters. No deployment or memory-retention facts. The alert is not corroborated by any observed fault, so no bounded root cause can be established; hand off for missing fault evidence.
missing_evidence: No error, timeout, or latency signal in current telemetry; need evidence of an actual checkout fault (error spans, 5xx logs, or p95 breach).
Need per-dependency latency/timeout metrics for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, and redis to test downstream-latency or redis-timeout.
Need db pool saturation metrics (waiters, active/max connections) to test db-pool-exhaustion.
Need memory-retention time series per service to test memory-leak.
Need deployment/configuration change records to test bad-configuration.
